Snacks

Banana avocado soft ice

Banán-avokádó jég

6 months+ Sound idea 120 min 4 portions

Offer a soft spoonful for sore gums or as a snack. Mash it if it firms up.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 large Ripe banana (Peeled and chopped)
  • 1/2 Ripe avocado (Peeled and stone removed)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Blend the banana and avocado until smooth.
  2. Spread in a shallow tub.
  3. Freeze only until just firm enough to scoop, about two hours.
  4. Mash it if any part turns solid.
  5. Serve straight away with a spoon.

Sound idea

Hard ice is a poor texture for sore gums. This should stay soft enough to mash with a spoon.

Blend banana and avocado and soft-freeze it, for sore gums as much as for a snack. Add no sugar.
